Subject: Initial supplier procurement checklist and evidence request

Hi Jake,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — excited to get Acme set up with Redwood. To help your procurement team complete vendor setup and issue a PO quickly, I put together the items we usually deliver up-front. Please confirm which items you need delivered now vs. after contract signature.

Required vendor-side evidence for contracting (please confirm acceptable formats):
- SOC 2 Type II report (summary + attestation). We can provide a redacted PDF of the full report and a separate supplier attestation letter.
- ISO 27001 certificate (scanned PDF of certificate and scope statement).
- Penetration test letter or summary (we provide an executive summary; full report available under NDA).
- Data flow diagram + list of data categories we may process (PII/PHI flags).
- Encryption and key management description (including KMS integrations).
- Insurance certificate (general liability / cyber liability).
- W-9 / tax form (for US billing).
- Remit-to / invoice instructions (bank wiring details OR remit email).

Attached: vendor_setup_checklist.pdf — a one-page intake you can share with Procurement.

Questions for your team:
1) Who should we send invoices to and what PO reference do you require?
2) Any specific vendor onboarding portal or vendor code we must register with?
3) Are there required wording or contract clauses in your PO (e.g., indemnity, data residency, subprocessors)?

Next steps I propose: I will drop the SOC 2 summary and a redaction plan in a secure folder once you confirm the NDA path; Marissa will follow up on technical scope if you want detailed data flow.

If helpful, we can schedule a 20-minute call this week to walk through the checklist and answer questions.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: vendor_setup_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

Rishi,

Appreciate the clear checklist — very helpful. A few quick notes from Procurement:

- Please send remit-to details and your IRS W-9 so we can set up your supplier record.
- Our standard PO terms are Net 45. Is Net 45 acceptable to Redwood? If you require Net 30, please flag.
- We can accept a redacted SOC 2 Type II report; procurement will want attestation and the control scope (in-scope services). Full pen test reports must be shared under NDA; an executive summary is fine for now.
- For insurance, we require cyber liability (min $1M) and general liability proof.
- We have an internal vendor portal and will send a registration link (you can create a supplier profile and upload documents).

Can you confirm the point of contact for invoicing and provide the remit email or bank details? Also confirm if Redwood will accept an Acme-issued PO with standard terms or if you need a separate MSA first.

Thanks,
Jake Turner
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corporation
